segments.name: real estate
segments.description: Owns and leases life science and technology campuses to tenants under long-term leases.
segments.evidence: Based on shared economic characteristics, we have aggregated our seven operating segments into one reportable segment for segment reporting purposes.

revenueModel.text: Life science and technology tenants pay rent under long-term leases.
revenueModel.evidence: We believe our unique business model and diligent underwriting ensure a high-quality and diverse tenant base that results in higher occupancy levels, longer lease terms, higher rental income, higher returns, and greater long-term asset value.
